3238.title: Server-owned user skill discovery skips symlinked roots and entries
3238.rootCauseOneLine: The server-owned skill scanner explicitly returns no entries for a symlinked user root and skips every immediate symlinked skill directory.
3238.proposedFix: Define a user-root trust policy, then canonicalize allowed root and immediate directory links, detect cycles, snapshot dereferenced regular files, protect mutation operations, and surface structured rejection diagnostics.
3238.caveats: Following links expands the current filesystem boundary, so a one-line stat substitution is not a safe simple fix.
